description: Live repro from ~/.agent-framework/sessions/home-tim-Coding-iocto-hmi-pc-scripts-iocto/2026-05-18-0929_cba0c5de, capture seq 17, tool call call_Dm171OzyxAAHvFZjRfdBk78d. The assistant ran a benign read-only rg search: `rg -n "href: '/config'|/config|Config'|Config\"|routes/config|configStore" iocto-website/src`. The PreToolUse hook denied it with `relative path execution not allowed: routes/config`. Root cause: bash-command-policy strips quoted regions with a regex that does not understand escaped double quotes, so the `Config\"` fragment prematurely ends the quoted region and leaves the subsequent `|routes/config` alternative visible to shell-segment parsing. The parser then treats `routes/config` as a command head and applies the relative-path-execution guard. Correct behavior: the entire rg pattern is one quoted argument, so `routes/config` is search text, not an executable path. Expected: allow.
